description: Spec section 4 (row 4, self-spawning) states the cloud-init is 'absent' and marks spawn 4-RED. This is contradicted by the very source the spec header (line 6) claims to have read ('skills/self/*'). cloud-init.sh is a complete 75-line implementation that emits full #cloud-config user_data with clawrouter.service + automaton.service systemd units, and it is actually invoked by run.sh:143 ('USER_DATA="$("$SKILL_DIR/scripts/cloud-init.sh" ...)'). Stating a built, invoked artifact is 'absent' is a fabricated status relative to disk and misdirects the entire implementation ordering (P5).

evidence.snippet: self-spawning | ... | 🔴 `skills/self/spawn` seed-transfer is a manual print (`run.sh:196`); cloud-init absent
